Looking through the paper text, I can find composition information for the BZH glass samples. The text mentions specific mol% values for Bi2O3 content in the different BZH glasses:

- BZH6: bismuth-free (0 mol% Bi2O3)
- BZH4: 6.25 mol% Bi2O3
- BZH7: 12.5 mol% Bi2O3
- BZH2: 25.0 mol% Bi2O3

The paper also mentions nominal weight percentages for BZH components from EDX analysis context (ZnO: 28.64 wt%, Bi2O3: 46.85 wt%).

The system is described as Bi2O3–ZnO–B2O3. Based on the explicit mol% values
